newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ Salmon half year loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: NZ Salmon half year loss narrows.

text.p: Note - New Zealand Salmon Ltd's sole activity is a 50 percent holding in the Chilean joint venture Aquacultivos Ltda.

NZ Salmon said the investment had performed poorly in the six month period through to March 31. Since then there had been further deterioration in the salmon market, to be reflected in the NZ Salmon trading results through to September 30.
With the persistent depressed market conditions there are major shifts occurring in the structure and ownership of salmon and trout farming assets worldwide, NZ Salmon said.

"The trend is towards fewer and larger producers, operator farming and integrated marketing activities internationally, with a total emphasis on maximising cost efficiencies, quality production and market access.
"The directors are well advanced in considering options for the future of Aquacultivos and are taking into account the international dynamics," it said.
